roadmap.goal: Learn the map, start the missable, bank early progress

steps.t: Play Chapters 1–2 (Fresh Out, Vice City Blues) and learn Vice City driving, shooting and switching.
Begin Positive Mental Attitude NOW: meditate at the 6 Vice City spots during Chapter 2; do not leave them to the end.
Try one of each activity (Master of None) as you pass them; the activity list is in the tracker.
Pick up hidden packages and letter scraps you pass in Vice City; do not backtrack later.
Save advice: keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 2, before any missable content; rotate 3 save slots.

roadmap.title: Start Smart — Chapters 1–2

roadmap.goal: Clear the Keys, keep the missable on track

steps.t: Play Chapter 3 (Keys to the Kingdom); the Keys have their own missions, activities and collectibles.
Meditate at the 3 Leonida Keys spots during Chapter 3 (lighthouse, southern beach, mangrove boardwalk).
Complete the Keys activities (boat races, fishing, diving) and buy the Keys safehouse for fast travel.
Finish Master of the Keys content while you are there; revisit after each chapter if new items appear.
Save advice: save before leaving the Keys; the bridge drive back is long and the next chapter moves on.

roadmap.title: Island Run — Chapter 3 (Keys)

roadmap.goal: Port Gellhorn and the mountains; the missable's middle stretch

steps.t: Play Chapter 4 (Port of Call) in Port Gellhorn, then Chapter 5 (High Country) in Mount Kalaga and Ambrosia.
Meditate at the 3 Port Gellhorn spots (pier, cliff, park) in Chapter 4 and the 3 mountain spots (summit, mill overlook, lake) in Chapter 5.
Do the off-road races, hunting and mountain activities in Chapter 5; buy an off-roader early.
Clear the 9 at-risk side activities that are easiest now (taxi, paramedic, firefighter, vigilante, bounty) before the finale.
Save advice: keep a save at the start of Chapter 5; the mountain content is spread out and easy to miss.

roadmap.title: Coast & Country — Chapters 4–5

roadmap.goal: Finish the story, protect the missable, lock the finale

steps.t: Play Chapter 6 (Going Home); it is the setup for The Big One, the final heist.
LAST CHANCE: before starting The Big One, confirm the meditation counter reads 18/18. The heist is the point of no return.
Finish the 9 at-risk side activities now if any remain; after the heist, some may become unavailable.
Buy the final properties and the best vehicles before the heist; the prep missions let you choose loud or stealth.
Save advice: make a dedicated save named 'BEFORE FINALE' right before The Big One; if the missable is incomplete, reload this save.

roadmap.title: The Final Stretch — Chapter 6 & the Heist

roadmap.goal: Free roam, finish everything, earn the Platinum

steps.t: After The Big One, free roam continues; use the 100% Ledger tab to finish collectibles, activities and side content.
Complete the 5 collectible sets (hidden packages, letter scraps, spaceship parts, monkey mosaics, serial-killer clues) using the app map.
Finish any remaining activities, races and challenges; the tracker shows what is left.
Complete Leonida Legend (100%) and Completionist's Dream (all side content); the Platinum pops when the 54th trophy registers.
Save advice: keep the 'BEFORE FINALE' save until the Platinum pops, in case a missable was missed.

roadmap.title: Cleanup — 100% & the Platinum

watch.why: The only missable. 18 meditation spots; finish before The Big One or it locks.
Taxi, paramedic, firefighter, vigilante, bounty and 4 more are easiest before the finale.
The most commonly missed 100% item; events appear randomly, so check the map often.
Rooftop packages in downtown Vice City are the most commonly missed collectibles.
Letter scraps and clues in the swamp are easy to walk past; use the app map.
Some ? missions only appear before the final chapters; do them as they appear.
Street races and nightclubs only appear at night; visit after 9pm.
The penthouse is the most expensive purchase; save early and buy income properties first.
Using cheats disables trophy unlocking for that session; do not use cheats on a trophy run.
